executive_summary.question: What punishment applies to abetment of an offence when the Sanhita makes no express provision for punishing that specific abetment?
executive_summary.generated_answer:
When the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 contains **no express provision** for punishing a particular act of abetment, the law falls back on the general rules laid down in Sections 49, 55 and 56.  

**Section 49** – *Abetment when the act is committed*  
> “Whoever abets any offence shall, if the act abetted is committed in consequence of the abetment, and no express provision is made by this Sanhita for the punishment of such abetment, be punished with the punishment provided for the offence.”  
> *[Chunk 6: e3cfd376-1174-46eb-9573-2b6cafe0dbc6]*  

**Section 55** – *Abetment of an offence punishable with death or imprisonment for life (offence not committed)*  
> “Whoever abets the commission of an offence punishable with death or imprisonment for life, shall, if that offence be not committed in consequence of the abetment, and no express provision is made under this Sanhita for the punishment of such abetment, be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to **seven years**, and shall also be liable to fine; and if any act … which causes hurt to any person, is done, the abettor shall be liable to imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to **fourteen years**, and shall also be liable to fine.”  
> *[Chunk 2: 320c1526-fed5-4985-ae85-e16910f24ab6]*  

**Section 56** – *Abetment of an offence punishable with imprisonment (offence not committed)*  
> “Whoever abets an offence punishable with imprisonment shall, if that offence be not committed in consequence of the abetment, and no express provision is made under this Sanhita for the punishment of such abetment, be punished with imprisonment of any description provided for that offence, for a term which may extend to **one‑fourth part of the longest term** provided for that offence; or with such fine as is provided for that offence, or with both; and if the abettor or the person abetted is a public servant … the abettor shall be punished with imprisonment … for a term which may extend to **one‑half of the longest term** provided for that offence, or with such fine … or with both.”  
> *[Chunk 3: a90a5461-96e5-4ff3-b754-c6e6c504fe4e]*  

### Summary of the punishment when no express provision exists
| Situation | Punishment (if no express provision) |
|-----------|--------------------------------------|
| **Abetted act actually committed** | Same punishment as the principal offence (Sec 49). |
| **Offence not committed – punishable with death or life imprisonment** | Imprisonment up to **7 years** (or up to **14 years** if hurt caused) + fine (Sec 55). |
| **Offence not committed – punishable with imprisonment** | Imprisonment up to **¼ of the maximum term** (or up to **½** if abettor/abetted is a public servant) + fine (Sec 56). |

These provisions collectively govern the punishment for abetment when the Sanhita does not specify a separate penalty for that particular abetment.

evidence_analysis.claim_text: When the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 contains no express provision for punishing a particular act of abetment, the law falls back on the general rules laid down in Sections 49, 55 and 56.

Under Section 49 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, whoever abets any offence shall, if the act abetted is committed in consequence of the abetment and no express provision is made by this Sanhita for the punishment of such abetment, be punished with the punishment provided for the offence.

Under Section 55 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, whoever abets the commission of an offence punishable with death or imprisonment for life shall, if that offence is not committed in consequence of the abetment and no express provision is made under this Sanhita for the punishment of such abetment, be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years and shall also be liable to fine.

Under Section 55 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, if any act which causes hurt to any person is done in the course of abetment of an offence punishable with death or imprisonment for life, the abettor shall be liable to imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to fourteen years and shall also be liable to fine.

Under Section 56 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, whoever abets an offence punishable with imprisonment shall, if that offence is not committed in consequence of the abetment and no express provision is made under this Sanhita for the punishment of such abetment, be punished with imprisonment of any description provided for that offence, for a term which may extend to one‑fourth part of the longest term provided for that offence; or with such fine as is provided for that offence; or with both.

Under Section 56 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, if the abettor or the person abetted is a public servant, the abettor shall be punished with imprisonment of any description provided for that offence, for a term which may extend to one‑half of the longest term provided for that offence; or with such fine as is provided for that offence; or with both.
